run_quadruped_demo: run the pybullet quadruped roll pitch yaw interactive demo script
connect_pybullet_server: connect to a pybullet physics server using shared memory or GUI mode
load_urdf_model: load a quadruped URDF robot model with a fixed base into the simulation
create_debug_sliders: create interactive debug sliders for roll, pitch, yaw, and xyz position parameters
reset_robot_pose: reset the robot base position and orientation using euler angles and xyz coordinates
